pages.text: Use an empty Soul Vial on an eligible living mob. Hover the filled vial to see what it holds.

Use a filled Soul Vial on a block face with space to release the same mob. A dispenser can capture or release a mob immediately in front of it. Save a filled vial for a $(l:enderio:souls/binder)Soul Binder$(/l) recipe.
Some mobs are restricted. If capture fails, test on a common animal, then consult your pack’s capture rules before bringing a rare mob back to the workshop.
A Void Vial holds liquid experience and can gather nearby XP orbs while carried.

Transfer XP Juice between a Void Vial and a compatible tank. Hold use on a filled vial to drink its stored XP. An empty vial also supplies the $(l:enderio:machines/enchanter)Enchanter’s$(/l) Mending recipe.
